Release-candidate rule

The release candidate must introduce no substantive implementation changes. Any implementation defect discovered during release validation must be handled explicitly rather than hidden inside release metadata.

Scientific governance

Process-derived evidence remains measurement evidence and is not automatically interpreted as a mental-state, clinical, ability, misconduct, or other person-level diagnosis.

Frontier estimators without an exact validated implementation remain explicitly gated; simpler estimators must not be silently substituted.
